svg.title: The seam/open-link assembly changes variables only by left/right multiplication and inversion, preserving the product Haar prior by iterated invariance. To make the splitting precise, list the seam variables, the two seam threads when present, and the open variables on the two halves. Assemble the original link configuration from these coordinates by their assignments and the endpoint gauge multiplications along the cut direction. Its plaquette reading splits the action into the two halves and seam factor. Gauge-invariant probes strictly in one half read that half and shared seam variables. Conditional on the seam, with half-action factors included in f, the unnormalized pairing is ZZ f(X)f(Y )Kseam(X, Y ) dX dY ≥0.
